prompt.context: Your client is the largest international integrated communications provider. They are looking at ways to retain existing customers and gain new customers by increasing their bandwidth for video content delivery. They have rolled the technology out to 5 pilot cities. They started this initiative to address three consumer trends: Time shifting (e.g. TiVo), Location Shifting (e.g. Slingbox), and Consumer streamed video content.
prompt.question: What factors would you consider to assess the client's strategy and how the trends will affect that strategy? What analysis would you do? What data would you collect? What other factors should be considered?

framework: Assess usage rates in the 5 pilot cities to understand bandwidth requirements at peak times
Evaluate customer satisfaction ratings from pilot users to refine product offerings
Analyze competitors in each trend category (time shifting, location shifting, streamed video) and benchmark product strengths/weaknesses
Estimate market potential and additional market share/revenue capturable from network expansion
Plan future network expansion based on pilot data

questions.prompt: What should the client measure from the pilot cities to plan network expansion?
questions.guidance: Candidate should focus on usage rates to determine peak bandwidth demand and extrapolate to full rollout. This informs both capacity planning and market sizing.

questions.prompt: How should the client use customer satisfaction data from the pilot?
questions.guidance: Satisfaction ratings help refine product offerings, assess how effective enhanced services will be at retaining existing customers, and determine appeal to potential new customers.

questions.prompt: How should the client evaluate the competitive landscape?
questions.guidance: Identify current competitors in each of the three trend categories (e.g., TiVo for time shifting, Slingbox for location shifting, Netflix/YouTube for streamed content). Use satisfaction ratings and market research to identify strengths and weaknesses. Explore potential to steal customers from similar service providers to quantify incremental market share and revenue.

brainstorming.prompt: What other factors beyond usage and satisfaction should the client consider as it evaluates the bandwidth expansion strategy?

categories.name: Competitive Dynamics
ideas: Partnerships or bundling opportunities with content providers
Risk of disintermediation by over-the-top players

categories.name: Technology & Infrastructure
ideas: Network capacity and cost of incremental bandwidth build-out
Infrastructure reliability and service quality at scale

categories.name: Regulatory & Legal
ideas: Licensing and content rights for video delivery
Net neutrality regulations affecting bandwidth prioritization
Data privacy requirements for consumer usage data

categories.name: Customer & Market
ideas: Customer willingness to pay for enhanced services
Demographic skew of early adopters vs. mainstream market
Churn reduction value vs. cost of network investment

categories.name: Financial
ideas: Incremental revenue per subscriber from new services
Impact on ARPU (average revenue per user)

recommendation: Proceed with national rollout if pilot data shows strong usage rates, high customer satisfaction, and a clear competitive advantage over TiVo, Slingbox, and streaming alternatives
Use pilot results to size the required bandwidth investment and set pricing to achieve an acceptable payback period
risks: Competitors may accelerate their own offerings during the rollout period
Bandwidth demand at scale could exceed pilot projections, increasing capital costs
Low satisfaction scores in the pilot would signal product-market fit issues before full investment
next_steps: Conduct detailed analysis of pilot city usage and satisfaction data
Benchmark product against key competitors in all three trend categories
Model financial return under low/mid/high adoption scenarios
Define network expansion phasing based on demand forecasts
